title: Windows: plugin installed but hooks fail because Git Bash was not found
body: Keyword-only decoy for RES-0014. Title contains plugin, installed, and hooks, but the mechanism is a missing Git Bash executable on a restricted PATH (Git installed under Program Files). Hooks.json is valid and would fire if bash were on PATH. Discriminating observation that MUST keep this out of the FC-11303 match table: hook scripts are registered in the client's hook table; the failure is spawn ENOENT on bash.exe, not an unloaded hooks.json.
